data_description.api_key: Create one at console.x.ai. Enable Voice access on the key to use speech to text and text to speech.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already configured

data_description.prompt: Instruct how Grok should respond. This can be a template.
data_description.chat_model: Non-reasoning models start answering soonest, which suits voice best.
data_description.reasoning_effort: Only used by models that support it (grok-4.5 and newer). Lower is faster.
data_description.web_search: Let Grok search the web for current information. Answers that search take longer.
data_description.x_search: Let Grok search posts on X.
data_description.voice: Default voice. A voice assistant can override it. Custom voice IDs are accepted.
data_description.tts_latency: Higher levels start speaking sooner, at some cost in audio quality where chunks join.
